notes: §2002:13.16.61.2 SR1 forbids a VALUE clause on a strongly-typed group item (§2002:8.5.3, first bullet). At --std 2002 the compiler refuses one with COBOL1703 in three places: format 1 in working storage (pb184-group-value-strong-subject), format 2 on a strong table element inside a STRONG typedef (g2-value-sr1-f2-strong, line 31), and a strongly-typed record under an output CD (g2-value-sr1-cd-strong, line 28). Each literal also fails §2002:13.16.61.2 SR11 (§2002:8.5.2); the cases pin SR1 by its own code.
